main_text.head: II.
main_text.p: SCANDIT ad excelsos Æterni Patris honores, Filius æternus, mens pia crede, vales. Obstructam Cœli portam reseratque aperitque, Obice peccati quæ tibi clausa fuit. Mens pia cum Christo Cœlum quoque scandere tenta; Scande pio nisu; scande pijs precibus. De terra totum Cœlos ascendere Christum Et vero hinc motu nonne migrare vides? Doctas GRUNERI, quas ecce, revolve pagellas; Et tota hinc motu mens pia scande pio. Has igitur GRUNERE tuas defende pagellas, Intrepidôq; animô Dogmata falsa nega; Gloria sicq; tibi superest, nunc accipe lauros, In Cœlis dum te certa corona manet.

p.i: Non tam moris quàm amoris ergò deproperabat.

main_text.p: J. B. S. S. Th. S.

page.notes: The verse lines are printed with the first letter of each stanza set larger (a decorated initial "S" and "D" style). Two lines of the stanza are printed with marks "[?]" omitted where the printer's punctuation is uncertain. The stanza beginning "Obstructam" appears printed as "Obstructam" with a long s rendered as a plain s throughout. Stanza-level layout is reproduced as a single paragraph per stanza where lines are run together in the scan; the verse lines are not individually marked as <l> due to the uniform prose-like setting. Some letters in the faint show-through text from the reverse page were not transcribed.
